tools.name: count_unread
tools.description: Counts the unread emails in the inbox.

de: Wie viele ungelesene Nachrichten liegen im Posteingang?
Zähle meine neuen E-Mails.
en: How many unread messages are in the inbox?
Count my new emails.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: Lists the most recent emails with sender and subject.

de: Zeige mir die letzten Nachrichten mit Absender und Betreff.
Von wem kam die neueste E-Mail?
en: Show me the latest messages with sender and subject.
Who sent the newest email?

tools.name: mark_all_read
tools.description: Marks every email of a folder as read.

de: Markiere den ganzen Posteingang als gelesen.
en: Mark the whole inbox as read.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists the appointments of a day or a date range.

de: Welche Termine stehen für morgen an?
Was habe ich am Freitag vor?
en: Which appointments are coming up tomorrow?
What do I have planned on Friday?

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Creates an appointment with a title, a date and a time.

de: Trag einen Termin beim Zahnarzt am Montag um 9 Uhr ein.
en: Put a dentist appointment on Monday at 9 am in my planner.

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.description: Deletes an appointment.

de: Lösche den Termin am Donnerstag wieder.
en: Delete the Thursday appointment again.

tools.name: find_recipe
tools.description: Searches the saved recipes by ingredient or dish name.

de: Welches Rezept habe ich mit Kürbis gespeichert?
Suche etwas Vegetarisches mit Linsen.
en: Which recipe with pumpkin did I save?
Find something vegetarian with lentils.

tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Recalculates the ingredient amounts of a recipe for a number of servings.

de: Rechne die Lasagne auf sechs Portionen um.
en: Recalculate the lasagne for six servings.

tools.name: add_to_menu
tools.description: Puts a recipe on the weekly menu.

de: Setze das Chili auf den Speiseplan für Mittwoch.
en: Put the chili on the menu for Wednesday.

tools.name: show_items
tools.description: Shows what is still on the shopping list.

de: Was steht noch auf dem Zettel für den Supermarkt?
en: What is still on the list for the supermarket?

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Adds an article to the shopping list.

de: Schreib Milch und Eier auf die Einkaufsliste.
Wir brauchen noch Butter zum Einkaufen.
en: Add milk and eggs to the shopping list.
We still need butter from the store.

tools.name: remove_item
tools.description: Removes an article from the shopping list.

de: Streich die Bananen von der Liste.
en: Cross the bananas off the list.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists the open tasks with their due dates.

de: Welche Aufgaben sind noch offen?
Was ist bis Ende der Woche fällig?
en: Which tasks are still open?
What is due by the end of the week?

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Creates a task with an optional due date.

de: Erinnere mich daran, die Steuererklärung abzugeben.
en: Remind me to hand in the tax return.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Marks a task as done.

de: Hak die Aufgabe mit dem Fahrradreifen ab.
en: Tick off the bicycle tire task.

tools.name: add_entry
tools.description: Adds a diary entry for today.

de: Schreib in mein Tagebuch, dass der Tag anstrengend war.
en: Write in my diary that the day was exhausting.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Searches the diary entries for a word.

de: Wann habe ich zuletzt über den Urlaub geschrieben?
en: When did I last write about the vacation?

tools.name: mood_summary
tools.description: Summarises the moods noted in the diary over a period.

de: Wie war meine Stimmung in den letzten Wochen?
en: How was my mood over the past weeks?

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Records an expense with an amount and a category.

de: Buch 45 Euro fürs Tanken.
en: Record 45 euros for gas.

tools.name: month_total
tools.description: Gives the sum of the expenses of a month.

de: Wie viel Geld habe ich diesen Monat ausgegeben?
Was kosteten mich die letzten vier Wochen?
en: How much money did I spend this month?
What did the last four weeks cost me?

tools.name: top_categories
tools.description: Lists the categories with the highest spending.

de: Wofür gebe ich am meisten aus?
en: What do I spend the most on?

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Records that a habit was done today.

de: Hak für heute das Meditieren ab.
en: Check off meditating for today.

tools.name: streaks
tools.description: Shows how many days in a row each habit was kept.

de: Wie viele Tage in Folge mache ich schon Yoga?
en: How many days in a row have I been doing yoga?

tools.name: log_workout
tools.description: Records a workout with its type and duration.

de: Trag einen Lauf über dreißig Minuten ein.
en: Log a thirty minute run.

tools.name: weekly_summary
tools.description: Summarises the workouts of the past week.

de: Wie oft war ich diese Woche beim Sport?
en: How often did I exercise this week?

tools.name: last_workout
tools.description: Shows the most recent workout.

de: Was habe ich beim letzten Mal trainiert?
en: What did I do in my last session?

tools.name: water_due
tools.description: Lists the plants that need water today.

de: Welche Pflanzen brauchen heute Wasser?
en: Which plants need water today?

tools.name: mark_watered
tools.description: Records that a plant was watered.

de: Die Monstera ist gegossen.
en: The monstera has been watered.

tools.name: add_plant
tools.description: Adds a plant with its watering interval.

de: Neue Pflanze: ein Gummibaum, alle zehn Tage gießen.
en: New plant: a rubber tree, water every ten days.

tools.name: loans_due
tools.description: Lists the borrowed books and when they are due back.

de: Wann muss ich meine Bücher zurückbringen?
en: When do I have to bring my books back?

tools.name: renew_loan
tools.description: Extends the loan period of a borrowed book.

de: Verlängere die Leihfrist für den Krimi.
en: Extend the loan period for the thriller.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches the library catalog.

de: Gibt es das neue Buch von Juli Zeh bei uns?
en: Does our library have the new Stephen King novel?

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: Tells which song is playing right now.

de: Welches Lied läuft gerade?
en: Which song is playing right now?

tools.name: play_playlist
tools.description: Starts a playlist.

de: Spiel meine Playlist zum Joggen ab.
en: Play my running playlist.

tools.name: skip
tools.description: Skips to the next song.

de: Das nächste Lied bitte.
en: Next song please.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: Lists the planned trips with their dates.

de: Welche Reisen habe ich geplant?
en: Which trips have I planned?

tools.name: days_until
tools.description: Counts the days until the next trip.

de: Wie lange dauert es noch bis zum Urlaub?
en: How long until the holiday?

tools.name: add_packing_item
tools.description: Adds an item to the packing list of a trip.

de: Setz Sonnencreme auf die Packliste.
en: Put sunscreen on the packing list.

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Starts a countdown timer.

de: Stell einen Wecker auf zehn Minuten für die Nudeln.
en: Set a countdown for ten minutes for the pasta.

tools.name: list_timers
tools.description: Lists the running timers and their remaining time.

de: Wie lange läuft der Wecker noch?
en: How much time is left on the countdown?

tools.name: cancel_timer
tools.description: Stops a running timer.

de: Brich den Wecker ab.
en: Stop the countdown.

tools.name: cards_due
tools.description: Counts the flashcards due for review today.

de: Wie viele Karten muss ich heute wiederholen?
en: How many cards do I have to review today?

tools.name: add_card
tools.description: Creates a flashcard with a front and a back.

de: Mach eine Karte: Hauptstadt von Peru, Lima.
en: Make a card: capital of Peru, Lima.

tools.name: review_stats
tools.description: Shows how many cards were reviewed and how many were right.

de: Wie gut habe ich letzte Woche gelernt?
en: How well did I study last week?

tools.name: save_bookmark
tools.description: Saves a web address with a title.

de: Speicher diese Seite für später.
en: Save this page for later.

tools.name: find_bookmark
tools.description: Finds saved links by a word.

de: Wo war der Artikel über Sauerteig, den ich gespeichert habe?
en: Where was the article about sourdough I saved?

tools.name: list_unread
tools.description: Lists the saved links that were not opened yet.

de: Was habe ich noch nicht gelesen von meinen Merkzetteln?
en: What have I not read yet from my saved pages?

tools.name: log_fuel
tools.description: Records a refuelling with liters, price and odometer.

de: Ich habe vierzig Liter getankt, Kilometerstand 81200.
en: I filled up forty liters, odometer 81200.

tools.name: consumption
tools.description: Calculates the average fuel consumption.

de: Wie viel verbraucht mein Auto im Schnitt?
en: What is my car's average consumption?

tools.name: next_service
tools.description: Tells when the next service or inspection is due.

de: Wann ist das Auto wieder zur Inspektion dran?
en: When is the car due for its next service?

tools.name: next_dose
tools.description: Tells when the next medication has to be taken.

de: Wann muss ich meine nächste Tablette nehmen?
en: When do I have to take my next pill?

tools.name: log_dose
tools.description: Records that a medication was taken.

de: Ich habe die Blutdrucktablette genommen.
en: I took the blood pressure pill.

tools.name: refill_needed
tools.description: Lists medications that will run out soon.

de: Welche Medikamente gehen bald zur Neige?
en: Which medicines are running low?

tools.name: log_feeding
tools.description: Records a feeding of the baby with the amount.

de: Die Kleine hat gerade 120 Milliliter getrunken.
en: The baby just drank 120 milliliters.

tools.name: last_feeding
tools.description: Tells when the baby was fed last.

de: Wann hat das Baby zuletzt getrunken?
en: When was the baby fed last?

tools.name: sleep_summary
tools.description: Summarises how long the baby slept.

de: Wie viel hat das Baby heute Nacht geschlafen?
en: How much did the baby sleep last night?

tools.name: today_lessons
tools.description: Lists today's lessons in order.

de: Welche Fächer habe ich heute?
en: Which subjects do I have today?

tools.name: next_lesson
tools.description: Tells which lesson comes next and where.

de: Was kommt nach der Pause?
en: What is the lesson after the break?

tools.name: move_lesson
tools.description: Moves a lesson to another slot.

de: Verleg Physik auf die dritte Stunde am Dienstag.
en: Move physics to third period on Tuesday.

tools.name: add_grade
tools.description: Records a grade for a subject.

de: Trag eine 2 in Mathe ein.
en: Enter a 2 in math.

tools.name: average
tools.description: Calculates the average grade, overall or for a subject.

de: Wie steht mein Schnitt in Englisch?
en: What is my average in English?

tools.name: list_grades
tools.description: Lists the grades of a subject.

de: Welche Noten habe ich in Biologie?
en: Which grades do I have in biology?

tools.name: sow_calendar
tools.description: Tells what can be sown or planted in a month.

de: Was kann ich im April aussäen?
en: What can I sow in April?

tools.name: log_harvest
tools.description: Records a harvest with the amount.

de: Ich habe drei Kilo Tomaten geerntet.
en: I harvested three kilos of tomatoes.

tools.name: tasks_this_month
tools.description: Lists the garden jobs for the current month.

de: Was steht diesen Monat im Beet an?
en: What needs doing in the beds this month?

tools.name: next_vet
tools.description: Tells when the next visit to the vet is due for a pet.

de: Wann muss die Katze wieder zum Tierarzt?
en: When does the cat have to see the vet again?

tools.name: log_pet_feeding
tools.description: Records that a pet was fed.

de: Der Hund hat gefressen.
en: The dog has eaten.

tools.name: add_vaccination
tools.description: Records a vaccination of a pet.

de: Trag die Tollwutimpfung für den Kater ein.
en: Record the rabies shot for the tomcat.

tools.name: show_watchlist
tools.description: Shows the films and series still to watch.

en: Which films did we want to watch?

tools.description: Adds a film or series to the watchlist.

en: Put the new Nolan film on the list.

tools.description: Picks a random title from the watchlist.

en: Pick something for tonight.

en: We have seen that one.

tools.description: Lists subscriptions that renew in the next days.

tools.description: Records a subscription with its price and billing day.

en: New: cloud storage for three euros a month.
